claim_boundaries: Measured on two Arc Pro B70 (BMG-G31), xe driver, Level Zero 20.2.0 / UR 1.14.37020, 230 W caps, C1, max-context 32768.
P2P was never enabled on this host (probe_p2p false); peer access ran through pinned-host staging. P2P-capable hosts are unverified.
Serial greedy decode is nondeterministic on open-ended prompts on this engine (pre-existing; HY4S_SYNCALL=1 does not fix it). Parity claims between arms are limited by that nondeterminism.
--draft dfly2 stays opt-in: biggest decode lever (2.2x at 28K) but parity is unverifiable; do not publish as lossless.
Depths beyond 28,672, peer budgets above 25 GiB, HY4S_XMX_I8=2, concurrency >1, and non-B70 GPUs are untested.
Requires native .strata packs (~120 GiB); the Q3_K_M GGUF cannot be loaded by this engine.
